methodology: Three serial runs of public native benchmark: 10,000 dense 160x50 frames each, 256 warm frames, GPU fence every 32 frames and at end. Input generation excluded. Parser + snapshot + packing + submission and fences included. This is GPU-completed offscreen throughput, not display FPS or physical presentation. Headline rounds DOWN the slowest run to a 500-frame/s boundary. No capture/fframes render runs concurrently. Other desktop applications remain running; no cross-device claim.
